get_operator_status.description: Read current findings and control readiness. This read does not change the monitoring goal.

get_operator_activity.description: Read existing observations only; this does not change what the vision model looks for. after_revision must be a non-negative integer written as a string: use "0" for available history or a returned revision for subsequent updates. Never use "latest".

watch_operator_activity.description: Wait for a new observation without changing the monitoring goal. Use an empty after_event_id for the newest available observation or the previously returned event ID; wait_seconds is a numeric string from "0" to "25".

set_monitoring_instruction.description: Change the active run's vision-model prompt and what it looks for. Requests to focus on, find, look for, watch, or detect a subject are monitoring actions, including "can you focus on find foreign object on the floor?". Put the requested visual goal in instruction, clear="false", analyze_now="true". This replaces the default target focus for subsequent batches and requests an immediate analysis. To restore configured targets use instruction="", clear="true", analyze_now="true". Report the goal applied only when command status is completed; acceptance alone means it is queued.

acknowledge_operator_notice.description: Mark a specific notice reviewed only when the operator requests acknowledgement. This does not change monitoring focus.
